story_type: cargo planes land and take off on a dirt strip
hook: Cargo planes landing on dirt, then vanishing in their own dust.
narration: These cargo planes are landing on bare dirt, then taking off inside their own dust storm.
Air Force and Marine Corps C-130 crews brought them down on Hubbard Landing Zone at Fort Huachuca, Arizona.
A C-130 can stop short on rough ground because its propellers reverse pitch and push air forward, like a brake.
The crews were students in the Advanced Tactics Aircrew Course, which has trained airlift crews since nineteen eighty-three.
[short pause] Then they went to full power, straight back into the dust.
outcome: Each Hercules climbed out of the dust cloud and back into the Arizona sky.
title: C-130s land and take off on dirt
description:
Air Force and Marine Corps C-130 Hercules crews practice dirt airfield landings at Hubbard Landing Zone, Fort Huachuca, Arizona, during the Advanced Tactics Aircrew Course on July 22, 2025.
